outcomes.question: How many delivery attempts do couriers make?
outcomes.answer: Our couriers make up to 2 delivery attempts [shipping-and-delivery].

outcomes.question: How long are parcels held at the depot after failed deliveries?
outcomes.answer: After the second failed attempt, the parcel is held at the local depot for "7 days" [shipping-and-delivery].

outcomes.question: What credit limit does a new wholesale account on invoice terms start with?
outcomes.answer: A new wholesale account moving to invoice terms starts with "an initial credit limit of £2,000" [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: How long do you hold an order when a payment fails?
outcomes.answer: When a payment fails, we hold the order for "24 hours" [payment-and-invoicing].

outcomes.question: At what temperature should I wash throws?
outcomes.answer: Wash throws at "30 degrees unless the care label says otherwise" [product-care-and-safety].

outcomes.question: When is customer support open?
outcomes.answer: Our customer support team is available "Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm UK time" [faq-general].

outcomes.question: How long do refunds take after you receive my return?
outcomes.answer: Refunds are paid to the original payment method within "5 working days after we receive and inspect the returned items" [returns-and-refunds].

outcomes.question: I would like to swap my vase for a different one. Can I do that?
outcomes.answer: We do not offer direct exchanges [returns-and-refunds]. If you would like a different item, you must return the original for a refund and place a new order [returns-and-refunds].

outcomes.question: If I buy something before lunch, how quickly does it leave your warehouse?
outcomes.answer: Orders placed before 2 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, are dispatched the same working day [shipping-and-delivery].

outcomes.question: How do I stop getting your promotional emails?
outcomes.answer: Every marketing email contains an unsubscribe link that you can use [customer-account-and-privacy].

outcomes.question: Is my personal information passed on to other businesses?
outcomes.answer: No, "We never sell personal data to other companies" [customer-account-and-privacy].

outcomes.question: What should I do with a wooden chopping board after washing it?
outcomes.answer: You should dry wooden items straight away [product-care-and-safety].

outcomes.question: Is this toy suitable for my two-year-old?
outcomes.answer: Toys and children's items are not suitable for children under 3 years unless the product page says so [product-care-and-safety].

outcomes.question: By when should a shop owner place Christmas stock orders?
outcomes.answer: Wholesale customers are recommended to place Christmas orders by "31 October" [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines]. The final date for guaranteed delivery before Christmas is "20 November" [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines].

outcomes.question: I am a wholesale customer ordering £600 of goods. Is UK delivery free and what discount do I get?
outcomes.answer: For a wholesale order of £600, UK delivery is free because "Wholesale orders of £500 or more are delivered free within the UK" [wholesale-terms]. You receive a "35% off retail prices" discount since "Orders from £250 to £999 receive 35% off retail prices" [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: I bought a gift on 10 December. What is the last day I can return it?
outcomes.answer: You can return it until 31 January [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines].

outcomes.question: How long does delivery to Australia take, and who pays any customs charges?
outcomes.answer: Delivery to the rest of the world, which includes Australia, takes "7 to 14 working days" [international-orders-and-customs]. For deliveries outside the UK, "the customer is responsible for any import duties, taxes and customs fees charged by the destination country" [international-orders-and-customs].

outcomes.question: A wholesale carton was sent to us by mistake. How long do we have to send it back?
outcomes.answer: Wholesale returns are accepted "within 14 days of delivery, and only for faulty goods or goods sent in error" [wholesale-terms]. Change-of-mind returns are not accepted [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: What discount does a wholesale customer get on a £500 order?
outcomes.answer: A wholesale customer receives "35% off retail prices" for orders from £250 to £999 [wholesale-terms].
